get_config_debug: get a jaxline experiment config for mag240m-lsc with debug mode enabled for smaller batch sizes
get_config_production: get a jaxline experiment config for mag240m-lsc with full production batch sizes and model dimensions
configure_optimizer: configure the adamw optimizer with weight decay and learning rate warmup schedule for graph neural network training
configure_model: configure the gnn model with mlp hidden sizes latent dimension message passing steps and dropout rates
configure_training: configure the bgrl loss with graph corruption settings and dynamic batch size for training and evaluation
